create_EC2_instances: create multiple AWS EC2 instances across regions using InstanceManager with a settings file
terminate_EC2_instances: terminate all running and pending EC2 instances and delete their security groups
start_stopped_instances: start up to a maximum number of stopped EC2 instances across all regions
get_instance_IPs: get public IP addresses of all running EC2 instances as a flat list or by region
print_instance_info: print SSH connection commands for all running EC2 instances organized by region
